name: Photo Sphere Viewer – Render Stunning 360° Panorama Shots
author: WPXERO

sections.description:
📸 Photo Sphere Viewer is a lightweight yet powerful WordPress plugin for displaying immersive 360° panoramic photos and videos. It supports multiple formats including JPEG, PNG, and MP4, allowing you to embed high-quality virtual tours across your entire website.

Designed for both Elementor and Gutenberg, the plugin enables creators, photographers, agencies, and developers to showcase interactive panoramic experiences without writing a single line of code.

✨ Key Features

  • Elementor Widget + Gutenberg Block Support
    Seamlessly add 360° panoramas using your favorite editor.

  • Interactive & Responsive
    Smooth performance on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

  • Customizable Controls
    Adjust zoom, field of view, autorotation, movement speed, and more.

  • Flexible Display Options
    Add panoramas to posts, pages, Elementor templates, widget areas, or WooCommerce product pages.

  • Optimized & Lightweight
    Minimal scripts and clean implementation for fast loading.

  • Beginner-Friendly
    No coding required — configure your entire viewer visually.

How It Works

📌 Using Elementor

  1. Open the Elementor editor.
  2. Drag & drop the Photo Sphere Viewer widget.
  3. Upload your panorama and customize display settings, controls, and styling.

📌 Using Gutenberg

Insert the Photo Sphere Viewer Block, upload an image/video, and configure your options from the sidebar panel.
sections.faq:
1. Which file types are supported?

Photo Sphere Viewer supports JPEG, PNG, MP4, and other common panoramic formats.

2. Do I need Elementor to use this plugin?

No. It works with both Elementor and Gutenberg, or anywhere shortcodes are supported.

3. Is the viewer mobile-friendly?

Yes. The viewer is fully responsive and optimized for touch interactions.

4. Does it support virtual tour controls?

Yes. You can enable/disable navigation controls, zoom, field of view, autorotation, toolbar items, and more.
